title: PinterestPinGenerator
description:
A multi-module service for automatically generating and publishing Pinterest pins.

Three components work together via Docker Compose:
— pinterest-core (Java / Spring Boot) — REST API and business logic
— pinterest-imagegenerator (Python) — image generation for pins
— pinterest-site (HTML/CSS/JS) — web management interface

Everything starts with a single command: docker compose up --build.
